gloss: to apologize; to make a formal apology

definitions.gloss: to apologize; to make a formal apology
definitions.explanation: To express regret and take responsibility for a wrongdoing, typically in a formal or public context. More weighty and official than simply saying sorry.

examples.japanese: {社長|しゃちょう}が{謝罪|しゃざい}した。
{会社|かいしゃ}は{不祥事|ふしょうじ}について{公式|こうしき}に{謝罪|しゃざい}した。
examples.english: The company officially apologized for the scandal.

examples.japanese: {被害者|ひがいしゃ}に{直接|ちょくせつ}{会|あ}って{謝罪|しゃざい}するべきだと{思|おも}う。
examples.english: I think you should meet the victim in person and apologize.

notes:
A formal word for apologizing that carries more weight than {謝|あやま}る or すみません. Frequently used in news reports, business contexts, and official statements. The noun form {謝罪|しゃざい} is also very common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {公式|こうしき}に{謝罪|しゃざい}する — to officially apologize
- {謝罪|しゃざい}{会見|かいけん} — apology press conference
- {謝罪|しゃざい}{文|ぶん} — written apology
- {謝罪|しゃざい}を{求|もと}める — to demand an apology
- {深|ふか}く{謝罪|しゃざい}する — to deeply apologize

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {謝|あやま}る — to apologize; more general and casual, used in everyday situations
- {詫|わ}びる — to apologize humbly; literary, emphasizes personal remorse
- お{詫|わ}びする — to apologize (humble form); polite business language

REGISTER:
This is a formal word. In casual conversation, {謝|あやま}る is preferred. {謝罪|しゃざい}する is appropriate for serious matters, official contexts, and public statements.
